title: Antique Pewter 30-Inch Wall Mount Towel Bar - Solid Brass Straight Bar - Carolina Collection (Traditional), Allied Brass
body_html:
Stop dealing with flimsy towel bars and hard-to-match finishes—this 30-inch Carolina Collection towel bar keeps your bathroom looking coordinated and built to last, backed by a Limited Lifetime Warranty in Antique Pewter, which offers a soft, silvery-gray tone with subtle warmth, bridging traditional and contemporary aesthetics.

  • Antique Pewter blends effortlessly with transitional decor
  • Pairs with matching Carolina accessories for understated elegance
  • Choose from 25 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Solid brass construction outlasts die-cast zinc and plastic alternatives
  • Finish your space with matching Carolina pieces for a classic, traditional bathroom

Specs

  • Product type: Bathroom towel bar (straight bar)
  • Collection: Carolina
  • Style: Traditional
  • Mounting: Wall mount; concealed screw mounting
  • Size: 30 Inch
  • Center-to-center: 30 in
  • Bar diameter: 0.75 in
  • Weight capacity: 10 lb
  • Screw size: #8 X1 1/4"
  • Included: Towel bar, mounting plates and all installation hardware
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Complete your bathroom with matching pieces from the Carolina Collection for a unified, traditional look.
meta_description: 30-inch wall mount towel bar in solid brass with concealed mounting. Traditional Carolina Collection style, 10 lb capacity, Limited Lifetime Warranty.
